sourceRecords.title: Area 12 · Smelter cavern
read: A cold furnace towers above abandoned ore carts. Beside it, a motionless wheel hangs over a dry channel. Green fire dances around a skull suspended above the armored dead.

Ore carts stand idle beside the furnace, and the wheel hangs motionless over a dry channel. Green fire outlines the skull and catches on the armored dead. The old machinery divides the floor into working spaces; the threat now occupies the same ground where miners once labored.

brief: Smelter cavern dominated by COLD blast furnace and mechanical bellows powered by stationary waterwheel. TEN-foot-wide DRY channel five feet below floor crosses room, exits north and east. Coal heaps and carts of unrefined ore. More than dozen withered dwarf/orc remains on floor, still inert; ONE skull surrounded by GREEN flame floats above them, initially visible. No flowing channel, molten lava or working miners. Flameskull provides local green light, rest dim.
